ICICI Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Bank at its meeting held on November 16, 2015, approved the proposed appointment of Ms. Vishakha Mulye, as a Whole time Director of the Board. The appointment is subject to prior approval of Reserve Bank of India (RBI), other regulatory and shareholder approvals and would be effective on the date of receipt of RBl approval. In this regard, the Bank has submitted a copy of Press Release.

ICICI Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the the Bank at its meeting held on April 26, 2013 approved the appointment of Mr. Dileep Choksi as a non-executive Director on the Board of the Bank effective April 26, 2013.

Icici Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board at its meeting held on May 23, 2010, approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of The Bank of Rajasthan Limited with ICICI Bank Limited. Further it has been decided to convene an Extra Ordinary General Meeting on June 21, 2010 to seek the approval of the Members to the Scheme of Amalgamation of The Bank of Rajasthan Limited with ICICI Bank Limited. Further the bank has also issued a press release on this regard dated May 23, 2010 titled "ICICI Bank Board approves merger of Bank of Rajasthan".

Icici Bank Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on September 04, 2006 approved the submission of an expression of interest to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) for amalgamation of United Western Bank (UWB) with ICICI Bank, pursuant to the order of moratorium announced by RBI in respect of UWB. A copy of the news release in this regard shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server (/Common/Corporate Announcements).
